fact: In its 20 May 2026 statement to the World Health Assembly, Burkina Faso said a national AI roadmap is being implemented and a Health Intelligence Centre has been created to support ethical use of AI in health decision-making.
title: DECLARATION sur les sous-points 12.6 et 12.10 (BURKINA FASO), 79e Assemblée mondiale de la santé
publisher: Mission du Burkina Faso, Organisation mondiale de la santé
